units.source_text: 我退出病室，又回到自己的房间。

en.t: I left the sickroom and went back to my own room.

units.source_text: 我看着钟表，查看了火车时刻表。

en.t: I looked at the clock and checked the train timetable.

units.source_text: 我嚯的站起身，系好腰带，把先生的信塞进衣袖里，然后从后门走了出去。

en.t: I sprang to my feet, tightened my sash, stuffed Sensei's letter into my sleeve, and then went out through the back door.

units.source_text: 我飞快地跑到了医生家，

en.t: I ran as fast as I could to the doctor's house,

units.source_text: 我想问清楚，父亲还能不能再坚持两三天，

en.t: wanting to ask clearly whether my father could hold on for another two or three days,

units.source_text: 请他想办法再维持几天，打针或其他什么办法都行。

en.t: and to ask him to find some way to keep him going for a few more days, whether by injections or anything else.
Unfortunately, the doctor was not at home.

units.source_text: 我没有时间在这里等他回来，心里很乱。

en.t: I had no time to wait there for him to return, and my mind was in turmoil.

units.source_text: 我马上叫了人力车，赶往火车站。

en.t: I immediately called a rickshaw and hurried to the railway station.

units.source_text: 我将信纸按在车站的墙上，用铅笔给母亲和哥哥写了一封信，

en.t: I pressed a sheet of paper against the station wall and wrote a letter in pencil to my mother and elder brother,

units.source_text: 信虽然很短，但总比不言语一声就走要好。

en.t: and although the letter was very short, it was better than leaving without a word.

units.source_text: 我托车夫立刻把信送到家里，

en.t: I asked the rickshaw man to deliver the letter home at once,

units.source_text: 然后义无反顾地跳上了去东京的火车。

en.t: and then, without looking back, I leapt onto the train for Tokyo.

units.source_text: 在哐当作响的三等车厢里，我再次从衣袖中取出先生的信，

en.t: In the clattering third-class carriage, I once again took Sensei's letter from my sleeve,
and at last read it through from beginning to end.
